notes.title: New Demo Update 0-21f1 available!
notes.content:
[h1]Good news everyone![/h1]

We pushed a demo-update for INU based on your playtesting and feedback.

Especially for the Next Fest we unlocked two more fractals that you can find by playing again!
But we have added even more:

[h2]new features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] screenshot synchronisation over Steam (limited functionality see Log [F3])
[*] three demo-fractal-adresses are now available
[*] tracklist near portal more diverse
[/list]

[h2]bug-fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] german instruction text (swapped left and right) now corrected
[*] loading of sound files optimized to avoid screen-freezes during loading
[*] introduced slow motion time near metaverse portals to avoid fly through
[*] increased slow motion time near mesoskop portal
[*] zoomer-intro soundchannel optimisation (rocket volume control, fade durations, fade exponents)
[/list]

[h3]And as always, thanks for playing! <3[/h3]

notes.title: Demo release on Feb 21 with Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
The day we have been waiting for so long!

After more than a year of passionate development, we can finally share INU with you.

The demo version will contain all the main gameplay mechanics and features that can be seen in the trailer etc. It will be even better, because we have generously reworked the colors of the fractals! Be curious :-)

[b]Wishlist INU now so you don't miss the long-awaited first chance to explore fractal infinity![/b]

The demo release is part of the Steam Next Fest from Feb 21 to Feb 28. During this week the developer and the rest of the team will be available for you to chat and ask questions. We are also going to do several live stream events during the week.

For more info about the game and the development progress follow us @robotheart_lab on twitter, insta and facebook.
